packages.title: Attio
packages.description: Synthetic Attio workspace (REST API v2 subset: people, companies, deals, attributes, lists and entries, notes, tasks, workspace members) Tool package for Firedrill

connections.title: Attio REST API v2 client (base URL override)
connections.instructions: Point the client's base URL at ATTIO_API_BASE_URL (it replaces https://api.attio.com; paths keep their /v2 prefix) and send ATTIO_API_TOKEN as the Bearer token. The token is the isolated Firedrill world token, never a real Attio key. Only the documented route subset exists; every other Attio path answers 404.

packages.title: Discord
packages.description: Synthetic Discord Tool package for Firedrill: a stateful Discord HTTP API v10 subset (guilds, channels, threads, messages, reactions, members, roles, DMs) at /api/v10

packages.title: GitHub
packages.description: Synthetic GitHub instance (REST API 2022-11-28 subset, GitHub MCP server tool names, browser app) Tool package for Firedrill

connections.title: GitHub MCP server tool names (get_me, list_issues, issue_write, pull_request_read, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to GITHUB_MCP_URL with GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN as a Bearer token. Eighteen tool names of the official GitHub MCP server are exposed as aliases next to the canonical github.<operation> names; results are the GitHub JSON objects.

connections.title: GitHub REST client (Octokit / gh-style base URL override)
connections.instructions: Point the client's baseUrl at GITHUB_API_URL and authenticate with GITHUB_TOKEN (sent as `Authorization: token ...` or `Bearer ...`); the value is the isolated world token, never a real personal access token. Only the documented route subset exists; every other GitHub path answers 404.

packages.title: Gitlab
packages.description: Synthetic GitLab instance (REST API v4 subset, GitLab MCP server tool-name aliases, browser app) Tool package for Firedrill

connections.title: GitLab MCP server tool names (get_issue, create_issue, list_merge_requests, accept_merge_request, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to GITLAB_MCP_URL with GITLAB_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. Twenty-one GitLab MCP server tool names are exposed as aliases next to the canonical gitlab.<operation> names; results are GitLab REST JSON objects.

connections.title: GitLab REST API v4 client (python-gitlab, @gitbeaker/rest or plain HTTP)
connections.instructions: Use GITLAB_URL as the instance base URL (routes live under /api/v4) and send GITLAB_TOKEN in the PRIVATE-TOKEN header. The value is the isolated world token, never a real personal access token. Only the documented route subset exists; every other GitLab path answers 404.

packages.title: Gmail
packages.description: Synthetic Gmail (Gmail API v1 subset + Google Gmail MCP tool names) Tool package for Firedrill, with a browser mail client

connections.title: Gmail MCP tool names (search_threads, get_thread, create_draft, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to GMAIL_MCP_URL with GMAIL_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. The 12 Google Gmail MCP tool names are exposed as aliases next to the canonical gmail.<operation> names.

connections.title: Gmail REST client (base URL override)
connections.instructions: Point your Gmail client's root URL at GMAIL_API_BASE_URL and send GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN as `Authorization: Bearer`. Routes live under /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/... with userId `me`. Test processes only; OAuth is not emulated.

packages.title: Google Calendar
packages.description: Synthetic Google Calendar (Calendar API v3 subset + Google Calendar MCP tool names) Tool package for Firedrill

connections.title: Google Calendar MCP tool names (list_calendars, list_events, create_event, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to GOOGLE_CALENDAR_MCP_URL with GOOGLE_CALENDAR_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. The nine Google Calendar MCP tool names are exposed as aliases next to the canonical google-calendar.<operation> names.

connections.title: Google Calendar REST client (base URL override)
connections.instructions: Point your Calendar client's root URL at GOOGLE_CALENDAR_API_BASE_URL so requests reach <base>/calendar/v3/... and send GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN as `Authorization: Bearer`. Test processes only; OAuth scopes and consent are not emulated.

packages.title: Google Docs

packages.title: Google Drive
packages.description: Synthetic Google Drive (Drive API v3 subset + Google Drive MCP tool names) Tool package for Firedrill

connections.title: Google Drive MCP tool names (search_files, get_file_metadata, create_file, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to GOOGLE_DRIVE_MCP_URL with GOOGLE_DRIVE_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. The eight Google Drive MCP tool names are exposed as aliases next to the canonical google-drive.<operation> names.

connections.title: Google Drive REST client (base URL override)
connections.instructions: Point your Drive client's root URL at GOOGLE_DRIVE_API_BASE_URL so requests reach <base>/drive/v3/... and <base>/upload/drive/v3/..., and send GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN as `Authorization: Bearer`. Test processes only; OAuth scopes and consent are not emulated; uploads must use uploadType=media with a UTF-8 body.

packages.title: Google Sheets

packages.title: HubSpot
packages.description: Synthetic HubSpot CRM portal (CRM v3 objects, search, associations v4, owners, pipelines, properties; HubSpot MCP server tool names) Tool package for Firedrill

connections.title: HubSpot REST client (@hubspot/api-client basePath override)
connections.instructions: Construct the client with basePath = HUBSPOT_API_BASE_PATH and accessToken = HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN (the isolated world token, sent as a Bearer header; never a real private-app token). Only the documented route subset exists; every other HubSpot path answers 404.

connections.title: HubSpot MCP server tool names (hubspot-list-objects, hubspot-search-objects, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to HUBSPOT_MCP_URL with PRIVATE_APP_ACCESS_TOKEN as a Bearer token. Eleven tool names of HubSpot's published MCP server are exposed as aliases next to the canonical hubspot.<operation> names and return the REST JSON shapes. The official stdio server itself is not the client being run: it talks to api.hubapi.com.

packages.title: Jira
packages.description: Synthetic Jira Cloud site (REST API v3 issues, JQL search, comments, transitions, users, projects; agile 1.0 boards and sprints; Atlassian Remote MCP Server Jira tool names) Tool package for Firedrill

connections.title: Atlassian Remote MCP Server Jira tool names (getJiraIssue, searchJiraIssuesUsingJql, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to ATLASSIAN_MCP_URL with ATLASSIAN_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. Twelve Jira tool names of the Atlassian Remote MCP Server are exposed as aliases next to the canonical jira.<operation> names; the official hosted server itself is not the client being run.

connections.title: Jira Cloud REST client (base URL + bearer token)
connections.instructions: Point the client at JIRA_BASE_URL and send JIRA_API_TOKEN as `Authorization: Bearer` (the isolated world token; Basic email:token authentication is not accepted). Only the documented route subset exists; every other Jira path answers 404.

packages.title: Linear
packages.description: Synthetic Linear workspace (GraphQL API subset on POST /graphql: viewer, teams, workflow states, labels, projects, cycles, issues, comments; official Linear MCP server tool names) Tool package for Firedrill

connections.title: Linear GraphQL client (API URL + personal API key)
connections.instructions: Point the client at LINEAR_API_URL (the GraphQL endpoint is LINEAR_API_URL/graphql) and send LINEAR_API_KEY as the raw `Authorization` header value, the way a Linear personal API key is sent. `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (the OAuth shape) is not accepted. Only the documented GraphQL subset exists; every other path answers 404.

connections.title: Linear MCP server tool names (list_issues, save_issue, get_issue, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to LINEAR_MCP_URL with LINEAR_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. Seventeen tool names of the official Linear MCP server are exposed as aliases next to the canonical linear.<operation> names; the official server itself is not the client being run.

packages.title: Notion
packages.description: Synthetic Notion workspace (REST API 2025-09-03 pages, data sources, blocks, comments, search, users; page-markdown endpoints; Notion MCP server tool names) Tool package for Firedrill

connections.title: Notion MCP server tool names (API-post-search, API-retrieve-a-page, …)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to NOTION_MCP_URL with NOTION_MCP_TOKEN as the bearer token. The aliases mirror the tool names and flattened argument shapes of the open-source Notion MCP server; the canonical notion.<operation> names are exposed as well.

connections.title: Official Notion SDK (@notionhq/client) pointed at this world
connections.instructions: Construct the client with baseUrl = NOTION_BASE_URL and auth = NOTION_TOKEN in a test-only process (the token is the isolated world token, never a real ntn_ secret). Only the documented /v1 subset exists; other Notion paths answer 404/405. Not verified against the real SDK yet.

packages.title: Quickbooks
packages.description: Synthetic QuickBooks Online (Accounting API v3 subset) Tool for Firedrill: customers, items, invoices, payments, accounts and the query language over deterministic local state.

connections.title: QuickBooks Online MCP tool names (get_customer, create_invoice, search_invoices, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to QBO_MCP_URL with QBO_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. Nineteen tool names of the open-source QuickBooks Online MCP server are exposed as aliases and return JSON objects. That server is a stdio process that calls Intuit itself, so point the agent at this endpoint instead of launching it.

connections.title: QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 over HTTP
connections.instructions: Point your QuickBooks client's base URL at QBO_BASE_URL (instead of https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com) and send QBO_ACCESS_TOKEN as the OAuth 2 Bearer token. Paths are /v3/company/9341453172839201/<entity>. Both variable names are a test-side convention: Intuit SDKs hard-code the host, so the client must be configured to read the base URL.

packages.title: Resend
packages.description: Synthetic Resend team (emails with synthetic delivery, domains, API keys, segments, contacts; Resend-shaped REST routes and MCP tool names) Tool package for Firedrill

connections.title: Resend-shaped REST subset (Bearer API key, JSON bodies)
connections.instructions: Point a client's Resend base URL at RESEND_BASE_URL and send RESEND_API_KEY as the Bearer token. Routes mirror /emails, /domains, /api-keys, /segments and /contacts; the calling key is the actor attribute resendApiKeyId, not the token. Compatibility with official SDKs is not verified.

packages.title: Salesforce
packages.description: Synthetic Salesforce org (Platform REST API subset: sObject rows and upsert by external id, SOQL query/queryAll, parameterized search, sObject Collections, Composite, limits, describe, OpenID userinfo; @salesforce/mcp data tool names) Tool package for Firedrill

connections.title: Salesforce REST client (instance URL + access token)
connections.instructions: Use SALESFORCE_INSTANCE_URL (no trailing slash) as the instance URL and SALESFORCE_ACCESS_TOKEN as the OAuth access token: jsforce `new Connection({ instanceUrl, accessToken, version: "62.0" })`, simple-salesforce `Salesforce(instance_url=…, session_id=…, version="62.0")`. Only the documented route subset exists; the OAuth token endpoints are not served. No client has been verified against this Tool yet.

packages.title: Slack
packages.description: Synthetic Slack workspace (Slack Web API subset at /api/<method>, the reference Slack MCP tool names and a Slack-client browser app) Tool package for Firedrill

connections.title: Reference Slack MCP tool names (slack_list_channels, slack_post_message, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to SLACK_MCP_URL with SLACK_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. The eight tool names of the archived reference Slack MCP server are exposed as aliases next to the canonical slack.<operation> names.

connections.title: Slack Web API client (base URL override)
connections.instructions: Point the client's API base at SLACK_API_URL + '/api/' (@slack/web-api: slackApiUrl; slack_sdk: base_url) and pass SLACK_BOT_TOKEN as the token; the value is the isolated world token, not a real xoxb token. Test processes only. Errors come back with HTTP 4xx/5xx status codes and Slack-shaped { ok: false, error } bodies; write methods accept application/x-www-form-urlencoded only.

packages.title: Stripe
packages.description: Synthetic Stripe test-mode account (customers, cards, PaymentIntents, charges, refunds, products, prices, invoices, subscriptions, balance; Stripe REST v1 routes and agent-toolkit MCP tool names) Tool package for Firedrill

connections.title: Stripe agent-toolkit MCP tool names (create_customer, list_invoices, create_refund, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to STRIPE_MCP_URL with STRIPE_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. Sixteen per-resource tool names of the Stripe agent toolkit are exposed next to the canonical stripe.<operation> names and return the full REST objects.

connections.title: Official Stripe SDK or CLI pointed at this Tool (Bearer secret key, /v1 REST subset)
connections.instructions: Pass these to your test process only. stripe-node: new Stripe(STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, { host, port, protocol }) parsed from STRIPE_API_BASE; stripe-python: stripe.api_base = STRIPE_API_BASE; Stripe CLI: --api-base. The Tool speaks the /v1 REST subset listed in its README; HTTP Basic auth and API v2 are not accepted.

packages.title: Xero
packages.description: Synthetic Xero Accounting API 2.0 (subset) Tool for Firedrill: organisation, chart of accounts, tax rates, contacts, sales invoices and bills, and payments over deterministic local state.

connections.title: Xero MCP tool names (list-invoices, create-invoice, create-payment, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to XERO_MCP_URL with XERO_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. Eleven Xero MCP tool names are exposed as aliases with the same argument names; they return JSON entities instead of formatted text.

connections.title: Xero Accounting API 2.0 over HTTP
connections.instructions: Point your Xero client's base path at XERO_BASE_URL followed by /api.xro/2.0 (instead of https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0), send XERO_ACCESS_TOKEN as the OAuth 2 Bearer token and send the header xero-tenant-id: 6d1c2f0e-4b8a-4c3e-9a51-2f7e0b9d4c11. Both variable names are a test-side convention; no Xero identity or token endpoint is simulated.
